As the original author, and a pretty lapsed SCP member, I want to thank the Image Team in general and weizhong specifically for going through the work to ensure this entry met Creative Commons compliance.

It's pretty good to know that the wiki has assembled a group of people willing to put in the effort to index articles that might damage out CC license, and otherwise attempt to balance the sometime dueling desires of maintaining license compliance while also doing good work to respect authorial intent.

The personnel and even the procedures will change, but the endeavor continues.

item.content:encoded:
Leicontis: Good point, which something I will rectify presently.

Agent Circeus: "a volume encompassing an area of approximately an acre." The acre is embedded is the volume that 188 acts over. Air is left unaltered, and the ground around it would have to be dug up to establish any effect, probably destroying many of the structures that 188 generates in the process. The area slice of the volume acted is the most directly observable piece of data the Foundation has. And to be technical, even the term area is a rough approximation of the slice of ground that the Foundation observes.
